Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: On persuasion of Husayn's cousin _____ ibn Ja'far, the governor of Mecca Amr ibn Sa'id sent his brother and Ibn Ja'far after Husayn in order to assure him safety in Mecca and bring him back
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: On persuasion of Husayn's cousin Abd Allah ibn Ja'far, the governor of Mecca Amr ibn Sa'id sent his brother and Ibn Ja'far after Husayn in order to assure him safety in Mecca and bring him back.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Further on the way, he received the news of the execution of his cousin _____ and the indifference of the people of Kufa
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Further on the way, he received the news of the execution of his cousin Ibn Aqil and the indifference of the people of Kufa.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: In response to Husayn's question about the situation in Iraq, the poet _____ explicitly told him that the hearts of the Iraqi people are with you, but their swords are in the service of the Umayyads
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: In response to Husayn's question about the situation in Iraq, the poet Farzadaq explicitly told him that the hearts of the Iraqi people are with you, but their swords are in the service of the Umayyads.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: The news of the murder of _____ ibn Aqeel and Hani ibn Arwa was reported by travellers
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The news of the murder of Muslim ibn Aqeel and Hani ibn Arwa was reported by travellers.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Upon hearing this, Husayn allowed his supporters to leave the caravan due to the depressing issues such as the betrayal of the _____
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Upon hearing this, Husayn allowed his supporters to leave the caravan due to the depressing issues such as the betrayal of the Kufis.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: But those who had come with Husayn from _____ did not leave him
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: But those who had come with Husayn from Mecca did not leave him.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: The news from _____ showed that the situation there had completely changed from what ibn Aqil had reported
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The news from Kufa showed that the situation there had completely changed from what ibn Aqil had reported. The assessments made it clear to Husayn that going to Kufa was no longer apt.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: The assessments made it clear to Husayn that going to _____ was no longer apt
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The news from Kufa showed that the situation there had completely changed from what ibn Aqil had reported. The assessments made it clear to Husayn that going to Kufa was no longer apt.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: In the area of _____ or Zuhsam, armies emerged from Kufa under the leadership of Hurr ibn Yazid
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: In the area of Sharaf or Zuhsam, armies emerged from Kufa under the leadership of Hurr ibn Yazid.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: With the weather being hot there, Husayn ordered water to be given to them and then announced his motives to the army and said: "You did not have an _____ and I became the means of uniting the ummah
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: With the weather being hot there, Husayn ordered water to be given to them and then announced his motives to the army and said: "You did not have an Imam and I became the means of uniting the ummah.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: If you support me, I will go to _____
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: In the area of Sharaf or Zuhsam, armies emerged from Kufa under the leadership of Hurr ibn Yazid. If you support me, I will go to Kufa.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: But if you do not want me anymore, I will return to my first place." _____ had stationed troops on the routes into Kufa
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: But if you do not want me anymore, I will return to my first place." Ibn Ziyad had stationed troops on the routes into Kufa.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Husayn and his followers were intercepted by the vanguard of Yazid's army, about 1,000 men led by Hurr ibn Yazid, south of Kufa near _____
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Husayn and his followers were intercepted by the vanguard of Yazid's army, about 1,000 men led by Hurr ibn Yazid, south of Kufa near Qadisiyya.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Husayn said to them:I did not come to you until your letters were brought to me, and your messengers came to me saying, "_____ to us, for we have no imam" ..
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Husayn said to them:I did not come to you until your letters were brought to me, and your messengers came to me saying, "Come to us, for we have no imam" ... Therefore, if you give me what you guaranteed in your covenants and sworn testimonies, I will come to your town.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Hurr responded that he would not allow Husayn to either enter Kufa or go back to _____, but that he was free to travel anywhere else he wished
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Hurr responded that he would not allow Husayn to either enter Kufa or go back to Medina, but that he was free to travel anywhere else he wished.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Husayn's caravan started to move towards _____, and Hurr followed them
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Husayn's caravan started to move towards Qadisiyya, and Hurr followed them.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: One of Husayn's companions suggested that they attack _____ and move to the fortified village of al-Aqr
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Husayn's caravan started to move towards Qadisiyya, and Hurr followed them. At Naynawa, Hurr received orders from Ibn Ziyad to force Husayn's caravan to halt in a desolate place without fortifications or water.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: According to Valiri, Hurr ordered his army to take Husayn and his companions to _____ without fighting and intended to persuade Husayn to do so
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: At Naynawa, Hurr received orders from Ibn Ziyad to force Husayn's caravan to halt in a desolate place without fortifications or water. According to Valiri, Hurr ordered his army to take Husayn and his companions to Ibn Ziyad without fighting and intended to persuade Husayn to do so.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: He suggested to Husayn to neither go to Kufa nor to Medina, rather write a letter to Yazid or _____ and wait for their orders, hoping to avoid this difficult situation by receiving an answer
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: According to Valiri, Hurr ordered his army to take Husayn and his companions to Ibn Ziyad without fighting and intended to persuade Husayn to do so. However, Madlung and Bahramian write that when Husayn was ready to leave, Hurr blocked his way and said that if Husayn did not accept the order given by Ibn Ziyad, Hurr would not allow him to go to Medina or Kufa.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: But Husayn did not heed to his advice and continued to Azad or _____
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: But Husayn did not heed to his advice and continued to Azad or Qadisiyah.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Husayn, however, was not afraid of death and stopped in an area called _____, on the outskirts of Kufa
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Husayn, however, was not afraid of death and stopped in an area called Karbala, on the outskirts of Kufa.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Later, a messenger from _____ came to Hurr and, without greeting Husayn, gave a letter to Hurr in which Ibn Ziad had ordered him not to stop in a place where Husayn can have easy access to water
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Later, a messenger from Ibn Ziad came to Hurr and, without greeting Husayn, gave a letter to Hurr in which Ibn Ziad had ordered him not to stop in a place where Husayn can have easy access to water.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: With this letter, _____ wanted to force Husayn to fight
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: With this letter, Obaidullah wanted to force Husayn to fight.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Zuhair ibn _____ suggested to Husayn to attack the small army of Hurr and capture the fortified village of Akr
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Zuhair ibn Qayn suggested to Husayn to attack the small army of Hurr and capture the fortified village of Akr.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: After negotiations with Husayn, Ibn Sa'd wrote to _____ that Husayn was willing to return
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Initially, he was unwilling to fight Husayn, but complied following Ibn Ziyad's threat to revoke his governorship. After negotiations with Husayn, Ibn Sa'd wrote to Ibn Ziyad that Husayn was willing to return.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Ibn Ziyad replied that Husayn must surrender or he should be subdued by force, and that to compel him, he and his companions should be denied access to the _____ river
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Ibn Ziyad replied that Husayn must surrender or he should be subdued by force, and that to compel him, he and his companions should be denied access to the Euphrates river.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Husayn and his companions remained without water for three days before a group of fifty men led by his half-brother _____ ibn Ali was able to access the river
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Husayn and his companions remained without water for three days before a group of fifty men led by his half-brother Abbas ibn Ali was able to access the river.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: The army advanced toward Husayn's camp on the evening of 9 _____
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The army advanced toward Husayn's camp on the evening of 9 October.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Husayn ibn Ali (Arabic: حسين ابن علي, romanized: Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī; _____ January 626 – 10 October 680 CE) was the second son of Ali and Fatima, a younger brother of Hasan and a grandson of the Islamic
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Husayn ibn Ali (Arabic: حسين ابن علي, romanized: Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī; 11 January 626 – 10 October 680 CE) was the second son of Ali and Fatima, a younger brother of Hasan and a grandson of the Islamic prophet Muhammad.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: It increasingly attracts participants from various religious backgrounds, including Christians, Jews, and non-Abrahamic faiths such as Hindus, Yazidis, Buddhists, and _____, who come to commemorate and mourn the martyrdom of Husayn
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: It increasingly attracts participants from various religious backgrounds, including Christians, Jews, and non-Abrahamic faiths such as Hindus, Buddhists, Yazidis, and Zoroastrians, who all come to commemorate and mourn the martyrdom of Husayn.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Mukhtar executed Kufans involved in the killing of Husayn, including Umar ibn Sa'd, Ubayd Allah ibn Ziyad, and _____, while thousands of people fled to Basra
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Mukhtar executed Kufans involved in the killing of Husayn, including Umar ibn Sa'd, Ubayd Allah ibn Ziyad, and Shimr ibn Dhi al-Jawshan, while thousands of people fled to Basra.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Sunni commentators such as Fakhr Razi and Ibn Kathir, _____, while narrating various narrations about the example of Ahl al-Bayt in this verse, consider Ali, Fatima, Hasan and Husayn as examples
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Sunni commentators such as Fakhr Razi and Ibn Kathir, in their commentary, while narrating various narrations about the example of Ahl al-Bayt in this verse, consider Ali, Fatima, Hasan and Husayn as examples.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Sunni commentators such as Fakhr al-Razi and _____ have also referred to this issue
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Sunni commentators such as Fakhr Razi and Ibn Kathir, in their commentary, while narrating various narrations about the example of Ahl al-Bayt in this verse, consider Ali, Fatima, Hasan and Husayn as examples.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Others such as Wellhausen and Lammens, view his revolt as premature and _____, while others like Heinz Halm see it as a struggle for political leadership among the second generation of Muslims
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Others such as Wellhausen and Lammens, view his revolt as premature and ill-prepared, while others like Heinz Halm see it as a struggle for political leadership among the second generation of Muslims.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Husayn's speech moved _____ to defect to his side
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Husayn's speech moved Hurr to defect to his side.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: The right wing of the _____, led by Amr ibn al-Hajjaj, attacked Husayn's force but was repulsed
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The right wing of the Kufans, led by Amr ibn al-Hajjaj, attacked Husayn's force but was repulsed.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Shimr, who commanded the left wing of the _____ army, launched an attack, but after losses on both sides, he was repulsed
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Shimr, who commanded the left wing of the Umayyad army, launched an attack, but after losses on both sides, he was repulsed.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Husayn's cavalry resisted fiercely and _____'d brought in armoured cavalry and five hundred archers
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Husayn's cavalry resisted fiercely and Ibn Sa'd brought in armoured cavalry and five hundred archers. Since Umayyad forces could approach Husayn's army from the front only, Ibn Sa'd ordered the tents to be burned.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Since Umayyad forces could approach Husayn's army from the front only, _____'d ordered the tents to be burned
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Husayn's cavalry resisted fiercely and Ibn Sa'd brought in armoured cavalry and five hundred archers. Since Umayyad forces could approach Husayn's army from the front only, Ibn Sa'd ordered the tents to be burned.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Husayn's son _____ was killed; then Husayn's half-brothers, including Abbas, and the sons of Aqil ibn Abi Talib, Jafar ibn Abi Talib and Hasan ibn Ali were slain
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Husayn's son Ali Akbar was killed; then Husayn's half-brothers, including Abbas, and the sons of Aqil ibn Abi Talib, Jafar ibn Abi Talib and Hasan ibn Ali were slain.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Abbas is highly revered for his loyalty to Husayn, his courage, and his death while attempting to obtain water from the _____ river for Husayn's thirsty children and companions
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Abbas is highly revered for his loyalty to Husayn, his courage, and his death while attempting to obtain water from the Euphrates river for Husayn's thirsty children and companions.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Abbas’s heroic death at the _____ of Karbala contributed to the development of a legendary figure
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Abbas’s heroic death at the Battle of Karbala contributed to the development of a legendary figure.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: At some point, _____, the infant child of Husayn, who was sitting on his lap, was hit by an arrow and died
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: At some point, Ali Asghar, the infant child of Husayn, who was sitting on his lap, was hit by an arrow and died.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: He fell on the ground face-down and an attacker named _____ ibn Anas stabbed and beheaded him
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: He fell on the ground face-down and an attacker named Sinan ibn Anas stabbed and beheaded him.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: This included two of Husayn's sons, six of his paternal brothers, three sons of Hasan, three sons of Jafar ibn _____ and three sons and three grandsons of Aqil ibn Abi Talib
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: This included two of Husayn's sons, six of his paternal brothers, three sons of Hasan, three sons of Jafar ibn Abi Talib and three sons and three grandsons of Aqil ibn Abi Talib.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Shimr wanted to kill Husayn's only surviving son Ali al-Sajjad, who had not taken part in the fighting because of illness, but was prevented by _____'d
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Shimr wanted to kill Husayn's only surviving son Ali al-Sajjad, who had not taken part in the fighting because of illness, but was prevented by Ibn Sa'd. There were eighty-eight dead in Ibn Sa'd's army, who were buried before he left.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: After his departure, members of the _____ tribe, from the nearby village of Ghadiriya, buried the headless bodies of Husayn and his companions
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: After his departure, members of the Banu Asad tribe, from the nearby village of Ghadiriya, buried the headless bodies of Husayn and his companions.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Husayn's family, along with the heads of the dead, were sent to _____
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Husayn's family, along with the heads of the dead, were sent to Ibn Ziyad. The historian Henri Lammens has suggested that this is a duplication of the report regarding Ibn Ziyad.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: He poked Husayn's mouth with a stick and intended to kill his son Ali al-_____, but spared him after the pleas of Husayn's sister Zaynab
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: He poked Husayn's mouth with a stick and intended to kill his son Ali al-Sajjad, but spared him after the pleas of Husayn's sister Zaynab. Yazid was compassionate towards the women and Ali al-Sajjad, and cursed Ibn Ziyad for murdering Husayn, stating that had he been there, he would have spared him.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: The heads and the family were then sent to _____, who also poked Husayn's mouth with a stick
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The heads and the family were then sent to Yazid, who also poked Husayn's mouth with a stick. Yazid was compassionate towards the women and Ali al-Sajjad, and cursed Ibn Ziyad for murdering Husayn, stating that had he been there, he would have spared him.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Yazid was compassionate towards the women and Ali al-Sajjad, and cursed _____ for murdering Husayn, stating that had he been there, he would have spared him
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The historian Henri Lammens has suggested that this is a duplication of the report regarding Ibn Ziyad. Yazid was compassionate towards the women and Ali al-Sajjad, and cursed Ibn Ziyad for murdering Husayn, stating that had he been there, he would have spared him.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: One of his courtiers asked for the hand of a captive woman from Husayn's family in marriage, which resulted in heated altercation between Yazid and _____
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: One of his courtiers asked for the hand of a captive woman from Husayn's family in marriage, which resulted in heated altercation between Yazid and Zaynab.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: After a few days, the women and Ali al-_____ were compensated for their belongings looted in Karbala and were sent back to Medina
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Yazid was compassionate towards the women and Ali al-Sajjad, and cursed Ibn Ziyad for murdering Husayn, stating that had he been there, he would have spared him. After a few days, the women and Ali al-Sajjad were compensated for their belongings looted in Karbala and were sent back to Medina.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: The killing of the prophet's grandson shocked the _____ community
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The killing of the prophet's grandson shocked the Muslim community. Prior to the Battle of Karbala, the Muslim community was divided into two factions largely over the issue of succession to the Prophet: whether Ali was Muhammad's designated successor or whether the prophet appointed no successor and had left the matter to the community.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: The armies met in _____ 685 at Battle of Ayn al-Warda; which resulted killing most of them including Ibn Surad
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The armies met in January 685 at Battle of Ayn al-Warda; which resulted killing most of them including Ibn Surad.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: The defeat of the _____ left the leadership of the Kufan pro-Alids in the hand of Mukhtar al-Thaqafi
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: To atone for what they perceived as their sin, they began a movement called the Tawwabin uprising, under Sulayman ibn Surad, a companion of Muhammad, to fight the Umayyads, and attracted large-scale support. The defeat of the Tawwabin left the leadership of the Kufan pro-Alids in the hand of Mukhtar al-Thaqafi.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: In October 685, _____ and his supporters seized Kufa
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The defeat of the Tawwabin left the leadership of the Kufan pro-Alids in the hand of Mukhtar al-Thaqafi. In October 685, Mukhtar and his supporters seized Kufa.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Later on, in April 687, _____ was killed
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Mukhtar executed Kufans involved in the killing of Husayn, including Umar ibn Sa'd, Ubayd Allah ibn Ziyad, and Shimr ibn Dhi al-Jawshan, while thousands of people fled to Basra. Later on, in April 687, Mukhtar was killed.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: He is buried in the _____ of Kufa
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: He is buried in the Great Mosque of Kufa.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: According to _____, the compassion that Yazid showed to the family of Husayn and his cursing of Ibn Ziyad was only for show
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Similarly, Madelung and Wellhausen assert that the battle lasted from sunrise to sunset and that the overall account of the battle is reliable. According to Wellhausen, the compassion that Yazid showed to the family of Husayn and his cursing of Ibn Ziyad was only for show.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: He argues that if killing Husayn was a crime its responsibility lay with Yazid and not _____, who was only performing his duty
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: According to Wellhausen, the compassion that Yazid showed to the family of Husayn and his cursing of Ibn Ziyad was only for show. He argues that if killing Husayn was a crime its responsibility lay with Yazid and not Ibn Ziyad, who was only performing his duty.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: According to Howard, some traditional sources have a tendency to exonerate Yazid at the cost of _____ and lower authorities
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: He argues that if killing Husayn was a crime its responsibility lay with Yazid and not Ibn Ziyad, who was only performing his duty. Madelung holds a similar view; according to him, early accounts place the responsibility for Husayn's death on Ibn Ziyad instead of Yazid.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: The eyewitnesses were of two kinds: those from Husayn's side and those from _____'d's army
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The eyewitnesses were of two kinds: those from Husayn's side and those from Ibn Sa'd's army.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Other secondary sources include al-Mas'udi's Muruj al-_____, Ibn A'tham al-Kufi's Kitab al-Futuh, Shaykh al-Mufid's Kitab al-Irshad, and Abu al-Faraj al-Isfahani's Maqatil al-Talibiyyin
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Other secondary sources include al-Mas'udi's Muruj al-Dhahab, Ibn A'tham al-Kufi's Kitab al-Futuh, Shaykh al-Mufid's Kitab al-Irshad, and Abu al-Faraj al-Isfahani's Maqatil al-Talibiyyin.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: The Battle of _____ was also reported by an early Christian source
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The Battle of Karbala was also reported by an early Christian source. Husayn's shrine stands on the site of his grave, where he was martyred during the Battle of Karbala.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Husayn's shrine stands on the site of his grave, where he was martyred during the Battle of _____
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The Battle of Karbala was also reported by an early Christian source. Husayn's shrine stands on the site of his grave, where he was martyred during the Battle of Karbala.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: His martyrdom is commemorated annually by over _____ Muslims inside Karbala alone, the day known as Ashura, which marks the anniversary of Husayn's martyrdom
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Every year on this day, over 35 million people in Karbala alone commemorate Husayn's death.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: The main event is the Arba'in pilgrimage, where up to _____ visit the city, the largest annual public gathering on earth
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The main event is the Arba'in pilgrimage, where up to 40 million visit the shrines.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: The Al-Abbas Shrine stands opposite the _____
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The Al-Abbas Shrine stands opposite the Imam Husayn Shrine.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: It is the mausoleum of Abbas ibn Ali, a son of Ali, a half-brother of both Hasan and Husayn, Husayn's standard-bearer in the Battle of _____, and one of his principal supporters
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: It is the mausoleum of Abbas ibn Ali, a son of Ali, a half-brother of both Hasan and Husayn, Husayn's standard-bearer in the Battle of Karbala, and one of his principal supporters. He accompanied Husayn during his journey from Medina to Kufa, and ultimately to Karbala.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: He accompanied Husayn during his journey from Medina to Kufa, and ultimately to _____
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: It is the mausoleum of Abbas ibn Ali, a son of Ali, a half-brother of both Hasan and Husayn, Husayn's standard-bearer in the Battle of Karbala, and one of his principal supporters. He accompanied Husayn during his journey from Medina to Kufa, and ultimately to Karbala.
